a: nm:maternal grandfather of michael max fleming

items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: My mother played piano. Her father played piano.

ctx.x: My mother played piano. Her father played piano. But my father played, and my aunts played, we call it the Victrola, the record player. So I had — my father made sure I heard every kind of music that ever existed.
